relationships.subject: ketogenic diet
relationships.evidence_quote: KD also inhibited the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and the TLR4/NF-κB signalling pathway in the dorsal root ganglion (DRG) in paclitaxel-treated rats

relationships.subject: ketogenic diet
relationships.evidence_quote: the PPARγ signalling pathway was significantly upregulated in the KD model

relationships.subject: rosiglitazone
relationships.evidence_quote: PPARγ agonist rosiglitazone significantly protected DRG neurons against cell apoptosis and reactive oxygen species generation induced by paclitaxel administration

key_findings: Ketogenic diet prevented paclitaxel-induced neuropathic nociception, upregulating PPARgamma and suppressing TLR4/NF-kB in DRG.
PPARgamma agonist rosiglitazone protected DRG neurons from paclitaxel apoptosis and ROS.
